prompt:
Some people think the money a region earns from visitors should be spent on protecting its traditions, crafts and historic places. Others believe it should go to roads, hospitals and schools that serve local residents.

Discuss both these views and give your own opinion.
instruction_line: You should spend about 40 minutes on this task. Write at least 250 words.
key_points: Both spending priorities should be explained separately and in a balanced way
Conservation side: if what makes the region worth visiting isn't preserved, the source of income is lost too; crafts mean livelihood and identity
Local services side: visitors already put wear on roads, water supply and health centres; it is fair for the income to go back to the people who live there
The writer's own opinion must be stated clearly; if a ratio or condition is proposed (such as setting aside a fixed share), it should be written precisely
The weak point of each side should be mentioned: spending only on conservation neglects local needs, spending only on infrastructure erodes the region's appeal in the long run
common_mistakes: Writing about the general benefits and drawbacks of tourism without ever addressing the spending choice
Arguing for one view and mentioning the other only to dismiss it
